description: This file defines a UI component named ProductCard using the LightningJS framework (imported as '@lightningjs/blits'). It renders a product's image, name, and price, updating its display reactively when the 'item' property changes. It also includes an input handler to navigate to a detailed product view.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays product image, name, and price, with reactive updates based on the 'item' property.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and sets up watchers for reactive property updates.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the 'enter' input event, navigating to the product detail page based on the 'item.id'.
